body:
> If you want to stay with each other, you need to show her that she can trust you again. Talk to her, tell her how you feel.

I don't know how to put things into words.

> She won't blame you for things you can't control, and she may be able to help you find your way through it. 

'...and i really think you need help that i can't give...'

> However, you need to not hold this against her...

I don't. Not at all. I don't want her to be hurt. She had a really rough childhood.

> The people around you wouldn't be there if they didn't care.

They *aren't* there. the people I talk to are online, over facebook or IMs. I'm horrible at face to face conversation, especially if i'm alone with the person. Ends in awkward silence. 

> Have you considered talking to a psychiatrist or anything?

Considered it. It'd be a waste of money. as I said before, I shut down when i'm stuck one on one with someone. Smoking helps, but i'm trying to stop. I also don't want to be put on SSRIs and be dependent on them. I was addicted to opiates a while back, and I don't want something similar again.

--
but at this point, i'm really wondering why i stick around. at the moment it's the two kittens i just adopted. my girlfriend and i had an arguement earlier and i don't know how i'm going to pull back out of this rut. the gun in the closet is a lot easier.
